sql: SELECT 'S' k, coalesce(best_yes_bid::text,'')||'/'||coalesce(best_no_bid::text,'') s, coalesce(trades_last_5m::text,'') tr, at::text at, '' x FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE market_ticker='KXYTVIEWSHIGH-KEN26DEC-5.0M' AND at > '2026-11-04 20:15' AND at < '2026-11-04 21:05' UNION ALL SELECT 'F', f.side||'/'||f.action||' '||f.price::text, f.quantity::text, coalesce(f.raw_fill_json::json->>'created_time',''), f.fee::text FROM fills f WHERE f.market_ticker='KXYTVIEWSHIGH-KEN26DEC-5.0M' UNION ALL SELECT 'O', side||'/'||action||'/'||status||' '||limit_price::text, quantity::text, created_at::text, coalesce(cancel_reason,'')||' '||client_order_id FROM live_orders WHERE market_ticker='KXYTVIEWSHIGH-KEN26DEC-5.0M' ORDER BY 1,4
